chunks: So that when We seize the affluent among them with affliction, they will begin to implore for help.
ai.seo_question: What happens to the arrogant when God's punishment arrives?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'mutrafihim' (the opulent/aristocratic) specifically denotes those who enjoyed worldly luxury while neglecting spiritual accountability, making their sudden cry for help ('ya-j'aroon') a poignant contrast to their prior arrogance. This moment captures the psychological collapse of the elite when divine decree overrides their material security, serving as a warning that wealth cannot shield one from the inevitability of judgment.
